validity.researcher_notes: This is the '柳城天然气支线管道工程' (Liucheng natural gas branch pipeline project), part of the 广西天然气支线管网项目 (Guangxi Natural Gas Branch Pipeline Network Project). All three URLs currently cited on this row's ref cells are dead: http://www.njsggzy.cn:180/... (ConnectTimeout, direct curl and WebFetch both refused/timed out, no Wayback snapshot), http://fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/.../t2198570.shtml (ConnectTimeout to the subdomain even though the parent domain gxzf.gov.cn responds; no Wayback snapshot), and http://fgw.liuzhou.gov.cn/.../t20200817_1926352.shtml (base domain fgw.liuzhou.gov.cn is live/200, but this specific document path 404s; no Wayback snapshot). None of the three has any archive.org capture, so the underlying documents cannot be recovered as-cited. Independent re-verification: found and read (raw HTML fetch, not AI-summarized) two live, unrelated-origin sources that describe the SAME project: (1) www.liucheng.gov.cn (Liucheng County government portal, notice dated 2019-06-14): '建设单位：广西广投天然气管网有限公司。建设项目：广西天然气支线管网项目柳城天然气支线管道工程。项目概况：柳城天然气支线管道建设，在柳城境内管道长度约28km，新建柳城分输站和社冲阀室' (owner Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co.; ~28km of pipe within Liucheng County; builds a new Liucheng distribution station + Shechong valve chamber -- the Liucheng distribution station matches the sheet's EndLocation field, which names '...柳城分输站' at Shapu Town, Liucheng County). (2) www.gxtngs.com.cn (the EIA consultancy engaged by the builder, two separate notices dated 2019-05-31 and 2019-09-16): '本工程位于柳州市柳南区和柳城县，新建管道线路全长约46km，扩建柳州分输站，新建柳城分输站、洛满阀室和社冲阀室' (project spans Liunan District, Liuzhou and Liucheng County; total new pipeline ~46km; expands the Liuzhou distribution station and builds the Liucheng distribution station + Luoman valve chamber + Shechong valve chamber). Total length ~46km from an independent EIA-consultancy notice is a close match to GEM's LengthKnown=45km, and the Liunan-District-to-Liucheng-County routing matches GEM's StartLocation ('Liunan Taiyang Town') -> EndLocation ('柳城分输站' / Liucheng distribution station). Two independent, non-GEM origins (county government + EIA firm) agree on existence, route, and approximate total length -> existence/route/length verdict is high confidence despite every originally-cited ref being dead. PipelineType='transmission' is reasonable for a ~45km, cross-county, mid-pressure (4 MPa per sheet) branch line feeding city-gate distribution stations; no basis found to dispute. Checked the 43-pipeline Guangxi roster for a duplicate/relabel: no other row matches this route (Liunan Taiyang Town -> Liucheng) or this combination of length (45km)/diameter (323.9mm); P7656 shares the 323.9mm diameter but is only 8.9km/0.67 bcm/y and unrelated in route -- not a duplicate.
